_comment: OAI behind FlexRIC, as in integrations/flexric/testbed (OAI's F1 RF-simulator CI setup): one CU (gNB_ID 0xe00 = 3584, PLMN 208/99) with two DUs, PCI 0 / NR cell id 12345678 and PCI 1 / NR cell id 11111111. OAI configs give nr_cellid in DECIMAL. 'e2_node_id' is the name llm_bridge gives the E2 node: MCC-MNC/nb_id. The target NR-CGI of a handover is plmn + nci.
